storyCards.headline: Old Town Road: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Lil Nas X's "Old Town Road" reached #1 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Old Town Road" is the debut mainstream single by the American rapper and singer Lil Nas X, first released independently in December 2018.

The song peaked at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 45 weeks on the chart.

Old Town Road was released in 2019.
